name: Computer Use
description: Revision-bound native app automation through the shared Cognia automation core.
author: cognia-next

browser.reason: Requires Tauri Rust commands for screen capture and input synthesis — desktop only.

tauri.reason: The plugin is a thin model-tool adapter over the canonical cognia-automation app-session commands.

mobile.reason: Screen capture and input synthesis require native desktop APIs — unavailable in the mobile WebView.

commands.name: /cu
commands.description: Show Computer Use status and app-session capabilities.

en.manifest.name: Computer Use
en.manifest.description: Revision-bound native app automation through the shared Cognia automation core.
en.slash.cu.body: Characters with `enableComputerUse: true` receive these tools on every send. Tier and consent live under Settings → Automation.
en.slash.cu.ready: Computer Use is available on this desktop ({platform}): app-scoped state, deep accessibility queries and revision-bound actions.
en.slash.cu.limited: Computer Use is only partly available on this desktop ({platform}):
en.slash.cu.unavailable: Computer Use is not available here: {reason}
en.slash.cu.noBackend: this app has no native automation backend (it needs the desktop app on macOS, Windows or Linux).
en.commands.cu.description: Show Computer Use status and app-session capabilities.

zh-CN.manifest.name: 电脑操作
zh-CN.manifest.description: 通过共享的 Cognia 自动化内核，按版本绑定地自动化操作本机应用。

zh-CN.slash.cu.body: 启用了 `enableComputerUse: true` 的角色将在每次发送时获得这些工具。等级与授权见“设置 → 自动化”。
